- **Sealed Deck** (issue #392): new deck type where each player gets an independently-randomized 45-card sealed pool straight to deck-building, no drafting phase; shown as its own top-level Format option next to Draft, always a Structure-deck-style pool.
- **Chaos Draft**: requires every player's round-start effect offer to be resolved before anyone can play; several visual fixes for the chaos delta/override badge (alignment, z-index, name overlap).
- **Open lobby matchmaking** extended to standard and team formats, with a player-count display fix and Chaos Draft listings hidden from players who haven't opted into custom content.
- **New Game dialog**: Opponent radio options stacked vertically, redundant reminder text removed.
- **Card stats**: fixed "times played" undercounting for every `RequiresOpponentDecision` card; Chaos Draft games excluded from lifetime/card stats, matching how bot games are already excluded.
- **Bot AI**: bots now always target something when playing Hate instead of leaving it blank (with an exception for mood-count value-scaling cards like Euphoria); a bot's own broken play attempt can no longer permanently break a game -- it logs and passes instead.
- **Draft deck-building**: the card picker is now sorted by color/rarity/name across every draft type, matching the existing "View draft pool" ordering.
